coverage_assessment: First-pass English, Dutch, French and German open-web research; 45 explicit original searches, 1,128 captured result headers, weekly/monthly, region/city, sector, retrospective and episode-specific searches. Sources include news, union and official records and one rights-organization report. The open web does not reproduce LexisNexis; some pages were technically unreadable or blocked; candidate gaps remain explicit. No exhaustiveness or absence claim. Current official baseline and reuse terms are pending coordinator verification.

query_capture_integrity.note: Original metadata exported from observed search actions. Parent capture audit distinguishes actual search actions from openPage/findInPage operations; no search was repeated to repair capture.
